known.title: Not done: prove saved unscored notes hold work after upgrade

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The adopted repo is synced to this release before the test creates the story or its unscored read, so `forge next` checks a newly generated read rather than one saved before upgrade. The unscored review is injected after sync, and the test calls `forge close` only after supplying a scored review. The required proof could pass even if an upgrade loses a saved read or `forge close` fails to block on a saved unscored P1 finding.
